title: Rust generic Stack receives unicast frames addressed to other nodes
description: LinkLayer authenticates and returns known-peer frames without destination admission; generic Stack::receive immediately decompresses/delivers them. RplStack has a separate wire_is_for_local precheck, demonstrating the generic path lacks parity. Enforce signed destination/address-mode/local IID admission before any upper-layer mutation for every production stack, with overheard unicast/broadcast/elided/multicast tests.
